designs.name: CR_001-qingyun-spirit-fox-card
designs.title: 青云山灵狐 · 卡面
designs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE polished portrait-format 2:3 bitmap for a Chinese cultivation card RPG art direction study. It must be rich, exquisite HANDCRAFTED PIXEL ART with HD-2D depth, not a smooth illustration with a pixel character pasted over it. Entire artwork uses the same deliberately visible square pixel grid, roughly a 256x384 native art canvas enlarged nearest-neighbor. Broad 3-6 output-pixel clusters remain plainly visible in faces, cloth, fur, stone and effects; sharp stair-step contours, carefully designed clustered highlights, selective outlines, restricted harmonious hue-shifted ramps, local ordered dithering. High detail comes from intentional pixel placement and layered silhouette design, NOT microscopic photo textures. Use evocative layered environment and depth through overlap, value separation, colored rim light and subtle limited pixel bloom; keep light shapes stepped and pixelated. No realistic 3D materials, no bokeh, no camera blur, no smooth anime face, no vector shading, no plastic voxel figurines. Mature premium RPG sprite-portrait aesthetic, refined character design and distinctive readable silhouette, not minimalist, not stick figures, not a tiny gameplay sprite. Subject occupies about 72-82% of frame height. No collage, no contact sheet, no watermark, no Roman letters or random writing. Asset type: complete illustrated card-face concept with a delicate 6%-width jade-and-aged-bronze card border. Leave a small unlettered dark jade nameplate at the bottom, NO text or statistics.
Canonical project facts: '青云山灵狐', common-rarity wood-element spirit beast found near Qingyun Sect's mountain gate; alert, suspicious, adept at ambush and retreat. Must be a fox animal, not a humanoid fox woman, not a nine-tailed divine fox.
Design: one young adult elegant single-tailed white/soft silver fox, jade-green eyes, charcoal ear tips and russet lower legs, a tiny modest braided green cord and weathered jade bead. Mid-turn on a moss-covered stone at a mountain gate, ears listening backward, one forepaw raised, large graceful bushy SINGLE tail curls into the composition. Fine fur conveyed by jagged pixel clusters and cream/teal shadow ramps, no realistic fur strands. Small curling wood-element leaf motes, grass blades, crescent trails, restrained green magic around paws; agile clever expression rather than enormous magical spectacle. Background: layered dark teal pines, mossy broken gate posts, a warm distant lantern and ivory mountain mist, all as chunky cohesive pixel art. Foreground fern and moss shapes frame the feet. A dramatic diagonal moonlit rim highlights the fox against dark jade foliage. Exquisitely textured but low-tier humble creature, not armored or crowned. Strong legible silhouette when reduced to card size.

Background predominantly smoky dark jade with simple silhouettes, SAME chunky pixel texture as the subject, supporting easy silhouette extraction. Worn charcoal and deep oxblood layered robes, rust-bronze belt fittings, dark red wraps on forearms, torn hems that reveal practical boots, a small broken ritual jade at the waist. Cloth tears, metal wear and embroidered geometric seals all made with readable chunky pixel clusters. Body in a prowling three-quarter stance; one hand directs a coiling crimson crescent spell while the other holds a narrow ritual blade low at his side. Crimson magic is opaque burgundy/red/coral/ivory pixel bands with square ember particles; it forms a threatening open crescent around his shoulder and leading arm, no smooth smoky gradient. A few dark shadow ribbons separate the silhouette from the background. Setting: small abandoned stone shrine vignette, cracked steps, charred grass, blackened bamboo silhouettes, a dim vermilion ritual lamp. Cohesive same-grid environment, predominantly smoky blue-black, warm red light catches the cheek, hands and robe hem; visible understated cool teal rim on the opposite edge. Dangerous grounded low-mid-tier enemy, NOT giant demon king, no horns, no wings, no excessive golden ornament.
